verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Canny's Autopilot extracting feature requests from conversations and call transcripts, and its MCP server letting an external LLM such as Claude draft PRDs from Canny data. Neither is Canny itself turning a plain-language feedback description into a structured set of proposed tasks. Autopilot produces feedback items rather than tasks, and the PRD drafting is done by the host LLM using Canny as a data layer, so both are only adjacent.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have AI turn a plain-language feedback description into a structured set of proposed tasks
